name: Gilbert
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Gilbert for 2026, and here is what he found: 16 family events, 10 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (A Christmas Carol at Hale Centre Theatre) through December 27 (Arizona Christmas Lights), with Illuminate the Season at SanTan Village (November 28), Journey to Bethlehem Christmas Festival (December 5 and 6) and Glitter on The Green (December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Gilbert

  • 16 Christmas events for kids in Gilbert
  • 10 free events, including Illuminate the Season, Journey to Bethlehem, Glitter on The Green and the Live Drive Thru Nativity at Barney Park
  • Meet Santa: Illuminate the Season (November 28), Gilbert Fire and Rescue Rides with Santa (December 5) and Santa Day at Mother Nature's Farm (December 12)
  • Lights: Riparian After Dark Holiday Light Trail (December 11 to 22) and Arizona Christmas Lights at Valor Christian Center (December 4 to 27)
  • Also new: A Christmas Carol at Hale Centre Theatre (November 27 to December 24)
  • Season: November 27 to December 27

Planning a bigger day out? Gilbert families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Phoenix, which covers ZooLights at the Phoenix Zoo, Las Noches de las Luminarias at the Desert Botanical Garden and the APS Electric Light Parade.
